Overview

Querétaro is a city in Querétaro with a population of 1,594,212. Fast-growing colonial city with a booming aerospace industry and beautifully preserved historic center. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
